name: aiuda-stack
description: Idea to shipped product on Flutter + Firebase + a React admin: the seven-phase spec, a scaffolded monorepo, a backlog in waves whose consistency is checked by code, developer agents that each own a lane, a QA reviewer, sprints run in parallel worktrees, and guardrails (git hooks, CI and an editor hook) that refuse changes outside the active issue. Also brings existing repositories into the method.
